name: Philistine
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Out of Mizraim came Casluhim, out of whom came Philistim: that is who the Philistines come from. Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth: this is Tyre and Zidon that you read about in the Bible.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
